findings.claim: MSCI's FY2023 10-K discloses BlackRock as its largest client organization by revenue, at 9.8% of consolidated operating revenues, with 95.4% of BlackRock's revenue to MSCI coming from asset-based fees on ETFs/non-ETF products using MSCI indexes — a concentration/single-client dependency risk factor.
findings.excerpt: our largest client organization by revenue, BlackRock, accounted for 9.8% of our consolidated operating revenues

customer_second_source.note: 查到歷史事件提及 Vanguard 2012 年曾把部分 ETF 從 MSCI 指數轉去 FTSE/CRSP、以及 Solactive 主打自助建指數搶中型資管客戶，但這兩條搜尋摘要沒有對應到可核實的單一來源網址與逐字原文，budget（4 search + 2 fetch）用盡前無法補證，故未列為 finding，僅供參考不列為可信 claim。
